scope: Single-D435i official_ego PX4/SITL diagnostic; diagnostic logs only; not N11-N16 acceptance evidence.

hypothesis.one_primary_variable: Enable EGO patch 0050 diagnostics-only logging at the final spline dynamics gate; do not change trajectory generation, limits, task, or acceptance thresholds.
hypothesis.basis: #337 and #339 were safely refused at the same final spline feasibility gate, but current logs lack per-axis velocity/acceleration maxima and individual normalized ratios.
hypothesis.criterion: Capture each final spline check and refine index with per-axis absolute velocity and acceleration maxima, limits, tolerance, velocity_ratio, acceleration_ratio, and overall ratio; use these measured values to identify the dominant rejected term.
hypothesis.termination: Any established N09 runner health/telemetry, clock, action, contact, or timeout failure preserves existing bridge-owned landing behavior. If the goal unexpectedly succeeds, continue through original 600 sim-second post-goal hold. No retries under this protocol.
